title: 第3550章 先去傀儡宗第3549章 被调教的不错
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
房间之中，柳青瑶已经换好了衣服，依旧是一套粉色长裙。
似乎……柳青瑶的衣服只有这个配色，无论是外衣还是内衣，都是粉色。
此刻，她双手捏着衣角，脸颊之上的红晕依旧没有消散，抬头偷偷看了眼李长生，不知道接下来应该如何面对。
顿了顿，深吸口气，柳青瑶终于鼓起勇气开口：
“前辈，可以转过来了。”
李长生微微一笑，转过身来，看向柳青瑶，眼睛一亮。
方才没穿衣服看着总感觉少点什么。
现在穿上衣服之后，整体气质瞬间提升了起来。
有了衣服的搭配，柳青瑶的肤色显得更加的白皙。
柳青瑶低头看着脚面，小声说道：
“前辈，接下来还需要做什么？”
李长生走到了柳青瑶身边，伸手拉起了她的手。
柳青瑶感受着李长生那温暖的手掌，娇躯猛地一颤：
“前辈……”
李长生扯了扯嘴角：
“这么紧张干什么？”
“我又不会吃了你。”
“坐……”
李长生拉着柳青瑶坐到了床上，开始为她把脉。
柳青瑶微微松了口气：

“怎么样了？”
李长生点了点头，笑道：
“放心，丹毒大部分已经清理干净了。”
“后续只要接着服用几次丹药，便可以完全清理干净。”
见此，柳青瑶微微松了口气：
“多谢前辈……”
李长生摆了摆手，重新召唤出神农鼎，开始帮柳青瑶炼制丹药。
不久之后，丹药炼制成功，一共三颗。
李长生将丹药递给了柳青瑶：
“这丹药你收下，三天一次，十天之后体内丹毒应该能够完全清理干净……”
柳青瑶接过丹药，再次表示感谢。
随后，气氛开始变得有些尴尬。
就在此时，房门被敲响，是侍女的声音：
“小姐，我们到灵墟界了。”
“是直接回柳家，还是直接去傀儡宗？”
柳青瑶看向李长生，脸上羞涩渐渐收敛：
“前辈，如果您没有别的行程的话，不如去我柳家做做？”
“看得出来，前辈应该也是想要见识一下药仙丹药。”
“反正明天拍卖会才开始，今日前辈就先在柳家休息，等明日我们一起前往傀儡宗。”
李长生微微沉吟，摇了摇头：
content_en:
In the room, Liu Qingyao had already changed her clothes, still wearing a pink dress.
It seems... Liu Qingyao's clothes only have this color scheme. Both outerwear and underwear are all pink.
At this moment, she was holding the corners of her clothes with both hands. The blush on her cheeks still hadn't dissipated. She raised her head and glanced at Li Changsheng secretly, not knowing how to face it next.
After a pause and a deep breath, Liu Qingyao finally summoned the courage to speak:
"Senior, you can turn around now."
Li Changsheng smiled slightly, turned around, looked at Liu Qingyao, his eyes lit up.
Looking at me without clothes just now, I felt like something was missing.
Now that I put on the clothes, my overall temperament instantly improved.
With the matching of clothes, Liu Qingyao's complexion appears fairer.
Liu Qingyao looked down at her feet and whispered:
"Senior, what else needs to be done next?"
Li Changsheng walked to Liu Qingyao and reached out to take her hand.
Liu Qingyao felt Li Changsheng's warm palm, and her delicate body trembled suddenly:
"Senior..."
Li Changsheng twitched his lips:
"Why are you so nervous?"
"I won't eat you."
"Sit..."
Li Changsheng pulled Liu Qingyao to sit on the bed and began to check her pulse.
Liu Qingyao breathed a sigh of relief:
"How's it going?"
Li Changsheng nodded and said with a smile:
"Don't worry, most of the erysipelas has been cleared away."
"As long as you take the elixir a few times, it will be completely cleaned up."
Seeing this, Liu Qingyao breathed a sigh of relief:
"Thank you, senior..."
Li Changsheng waved his hand, summoned the Shennong Cauldron again, and began to help Liu Qingyao refine the elixir.
Soon after, the elixir was successfully refined, and there were three pills in total.
Li Changsheng handed the elixir to Liu Qingyao:
"Take this elixir once every three days. After ten days, the erysipelas in your body should be completely cleansed..."
Liu Qingyao took the elixir and expressed her gratitude again.
Then the atmosphere started to get a little awkward.
At this moment, there was a knock on the door, and it was the voice of the maid:
"Miss, we have arrived at the Lingxu Realm."
"Should we go directly back to the Liu family or go directly to the Puppet Sect?"
Liu Qingyao looked at Li Changsheng, her shyness gradually faded away:
"Senior, if you have no other plans, why not go to my Liu's house?"
"It can be seen that the seniors also want to see the elixir."
"Anyway, the auction won't start until tomorrow. Today, senior will rest at Liu's house and we will go to the Puppet Sect together tomorrow."
Li Changsheng pondered slightly and shook his head:
